commands.review_summary:
The PR changes the Discord thread-update listener to reset sessions on archive and call Discord’s thread-members endpoint when a thread update reports an active thread.

PR surface: Source +12. Total +12 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. from source and the contributor’s production trace: restart while a thread is archived, then deliver an active-thread update. The missing current-main rejoin path and after-fix message actions make the reported recovery path high-confidence.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The remaining blocker is a small mechanical listener-state repair with a clear validation boundary.

target.title: fix(discord): rejoin threads on unarchive to restore MESSAGE_CREATE events
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a Discord thread is auto-archived and the gateway later restarts, the bot is no longer a thread member (archived threads are excluded from `THREAD_LIST_SYNC`). If a user subsequently sends a message — which causes Discord to unarchive the thread — the `DiscordThreadUpdateListener` receives the `THREAD_UPDATE` event but returns early because `isThreadArchived(data)` is `false`. The bot never rejoins the thread, so all subsequent `MESSAGE_CREATE` events for that thread are silently lost.

This means the bot becomes permanently unresponsive in any thread that happened to be archived at the time of a gateway restart, even after the thread is unarchived by user activity.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `DiscordThreadUpdateListener` only handles the archive transition (closing sessions). It has no handling for the unarchive transition. This is a gap in the thread lifecycle management that causes silent message loss — the hardest kind of bug to diagnose because there are no errors in the logs.

## User Impact

**Before:** Bot silently stops responding in threads that were archived during a gateway restart. Users see no error, no reaction, nothing — messages simply vanish into the void.

**After:** When a thread is unarchived, the bot automatically rejoins it via `PUT /channels/{id}/thread-members/@me` (idempotent — Discord returns 204 if already a member). A log line confirms the rejoin for observability.

## Changes

- `extensions/discord/src/monitor/listeners.ts` — restructured `DiscordThreadUpdateListener.handle` to branch on archive vs unarchive:
  - **Archive** (existing behavior, unchanged): close/reset thread sessions
  - **Unarchive** (new): call Discord REST API to rejoin the thread, log success/failure

## Evidence

- Observed in production: gateway restarted → threads archived at restart time became permanently unresponsive → zero log entries for inbound messages on those threads
- Gateway log showed `thread archived — reset sessions` events but no corresponding rejoin on unarchive
- Fix confirmed: after deploying this patch, `Discord thread unarchived — rejoined thread` appears in logs and the bot resumes responding

## Test plan

- [ ] Gateway restart with archived threads → unarchive by sending a message → bot responds
- [ ] Bot already a member of an unarchived thread → PUT returns 204, no error
- [ ] REST call failure (e.g., permissions) → logged as warning, does not crash the gateway
